lines.text: Sound moves four times faster in water.
lines.caption: Sound moves 4× faster in water.

lines.text: And that's not even the fastest it can go.
In air, sound covers about three hundred forty-three meters every second.
lines.caption: In air, sound covers about 343 meters every second.

lines.text: In water? About one thousand four hundred eighty.
lines.caption: In water? About 1,480.

lines.text: Race it over one kilometer, and water wins by more than two seconds.
lines.caption: Race it over 1 kilometer, and water wins by more than 2 seconds.

lines.text: Why? Water is much harder to squeeze, so each push is passed along faster.
And through steel, sound races about seventeen times faster than in air.
lines.caption: And through steel, sound races about 17× faster than in air.

lines.text: Sounds fake? It's true. Follow for more.
